habitat: 개활 습지, 얕은 호소, 큰 하천, 하구의 진흙밭과 갯벌, 해안의 작은 섬

months.note: 9월에 찾아오기 시작해 이듬해 5월까지 머물며, 6~8월에도 해마다 적은 수가 남아 기록된다.

summary: 아주 드물게 겨울을 나거나 지나가는 저어새류로, 서남해안의 강 하구와 습지, 제주도 등지에서 작은 무리가 겨울을 난다. 트인 습지, 얕은 호소, 큰 하천, 하구의 진흙밭이나 갯벌, 바위와 모래로 덮인 작은 바닷가 섬 등에 산다. 물고기, 개구리, 올챙이, 조개류와 그 밖의 연체동물, 곤충 따위를 잡아먹는다.

points.en: flat, spoon-shaped bill with a yellow tip
long yellow crest plumes on the nape (breeding)
bare skin around the eye, chin and centre of throat (non-breeding)
yellowish-brown collar on the lower neck (breeding)

young: 어린새는 어른새 겨울깃과 비슷하나 첫째날개깃과 첫째날개덮깃 끝이 검어, 날 때 날개 끝이 검게 보인다.

similar.how: 저어새는 부리 전체와 눈앞 맨살이 검어 얼굴 앞쪽이 온통 검게 보이고, 몸집이 조금 작다.

art.subject: Eurasian Spoonbill (Platalea leucorodia), adult in winter (non-breeding) plumage, as seen on Korean estuaries from November to March: plumage entirely white, with no long crest and no buff breast band; white feathering covers the forehead and lores up to the bill base, apart from a narrow black line from the eye to the gape; a small patch of bare yellowish skin on the chin and centre of the throat. Bill long, flat and spatulate, black with fine wavy cross-ridges and a yellow tip to the spoon; iris red; legs and feet black.
art.pose: wading in shallow estuary water, side view
art.scene: Korean winter estuary on the southwest coast: mudflats and shallow channels with reed edges; no people, buildings or text
views: adult non-breeding, side view wading: all-white body, long flat black spoon-shaped bill with a yellow tip, white-feathered face with a thin black eye-to-bill line, black legs
adult breeding (spring), side view standing: long yellowish nape plumes, yellow-brown band across the lower neck, yellow-orange bare chin and throat, yellow-tipped black spoon bill
adult, flight side view: neck stretched straight forward, legs trailing, all-white wings, spoon bill
art.build: Large white wading bird, about 86cm, a little smaller than a Grey Heron, with a long neck and long legs. Bill much longer than the head, straight and flattened, widening at the end into a broad rounded spoon. Legs long and black, the lower thigh bare. Wades in shallow water sweeping the bill from side to side. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip. Tail short and square. Flies with the neck stretched straight out and the legs trailing; adult wings all white, immatures with black wingtips.
avoid: Do not paint black bare skin around the eye joining the bill or an all-black bill; that is Black-faced Spoonbill (Platalea minor).
Do not show the breeding crest or the yellow neck band on the winter scene bird.
Do not draw it flying with a folded S-shaped neck like a heron.
Do not paint pink or red legs; they are black.
